title: Slippery Chain Shirt
summary: Medium armour that enables a Disengage after healing.

fields.Armour Class: 13 + Dexterity modifier, maximum +2 Dexterity. Medium Armour proficiency.
fields.Cautious Healer: Healing yourself or another creature automatically gives the wearer Disengage. You can move without provoking Opportunity Attacks. It does not trigger Cloak of Cunning Brume.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
